name: integer_parity
description: Even/odd classification of small integers in demonstrated completion format, with matched number-copying controls.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];controls=[]
prefix='Classify each integer as even or odd.
Integer: 4. Parity: even
Integer: 7. Parity: odd
Integer: 12. Parity: even
Integer: 15. Parity: odd
'
cp='Copy each integer.
Integer: 4. Copy: 4
Integer: 7. Copy: 7
Integer: 12. Copy: 12
Integer: 15. Copy: 15
'
for n in random.sample(list(range(2,122)),120):
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+f'Integer: {n}. Parity:','answer':' '+('even' if n%2==0 else 'odd')})
 controls.append({'prompt':cp+f'Integer: {n}. Copy:','answer':' '+str(n)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':controls},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
